description: This class provides logic for finding differences between two ConfigurationImage objects, specifically identifying ranges of change to facilitate diff operations sent to an ECU.

classes.name: ConfigurationImageDiff
classes.description: Contains static methods for computing differences between ConfigurationImage instances.

methods.name: findDifferences
methods.description: Finds the range of differences between two ConfigurationImage objects starting from a given position. Returns null if there are no differences.
